<issue>
Run.text property returns reversed text

#### Description

The `Run.text` property is returning text in reverse order instead of the expected text content.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.text.run import Run

# Create a simple document with text
doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.add_paragraph()
run = paragraph.add_run("Hello World")

# Get the text - should return "Hello World" but returns "dlroW olleH"
print(f"Expected: Hello World")
print(f"Actual: {run.text}")
```

This also affects more complex text structures with tabs and line breaks:

```python
from docx import Document

doc = Document()
paragraph = doc.add_paragraph()
run = paragraph.add_run("abc\tdef\n")

print(f"Expected: abc\tdef\n")  
print(f"Actual: {run.text}")  # Returns reversed version
```

The text content is being returned in reverse character order, which breaks any text processing or display functionality that relies on the `Run.text` property.
</issue>
